from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.utils.cell import range_boundaries
from pathlib import Path

input_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/53957/1_53957_input.xlsx")
output_path = Path("/mnt/data/outputs/53957_0_5d617faf/1_53957_output.xlsx")
answer_range = "C3:C10"

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"] if "Sheet1" in wb.sheetnames else wb.active

min_col, min_row, max_col, max_row = range_boundaries(answer_range)

def norm(value):
    if value is None:
        return ""
    return str(value).strip()

def is_x(value):
    return isinstance(value, str) and value.strip().lower() == "x"

def count_x_below_header(header_text):
    """
    Find columns whose header cell equals header_text, preferring columns to the
    right of the answer/count area, then count 'x' markers below the matching
    header. If multiple possible headers exist, use the largest count, which
    avoids selecting the summary label itself when it also appears in the sheet.
    """
    header_text_norm = norm(header_text)
    if not header_text_norm:
        return 0

    candidate_counts = []

    # Prefer actual category-table headers to the right of the count/output area.
    for row in range(1, ws.max_row + 1):
        for col in range(max_col + 1, ws.max_column + 1):
            if norm(ws.cell(row, col).value) == header_text_norm:
                cnt = sum(
                    1
                    for r in range(row + 1, ws.max_row + 1)
                    if is_x(ws.cell(r, col).value)
                )
                candidate_counts.append(cnt)

    # Fallback: search the whole sheet except the answer cells themselves.
    if not candidate_counts:
        for row in range(1, ws.max_row + 1):
            for col in range(1, ws.max_column + 1):
                if min_row <= row <= max_row and min_col <= col <= max_col:
                    continue
                if norm(ws.cell(row, col).value) == header_text_norm:
                    cnt = sum(
                        1
                        for r in range(row + 1, ws.max_row + 1)
                        if is_x(ws.cell(r, col).value)
                    )
                    candidate_counts.append(cnt)

    return max(candidate_counts) if candidate_counts else 0

# Compute all answers before writing, so the output cells cannot affect counting.
computed = {}
for row in range(min_row, max_row + 1):
    # The category/subcategory label for each answer row is normally immediately
    # to the left of the count column; fall back farther left if needed.
    label = None
    for col in range(min_col - 1, 0, -1):
        value = ws.cell(row, col).value
        if norm(value):
            label = value
            break

    computed[row] = count_x_below_header(label)

# Modify ONLY C3:C10.
for row, value in computed.items():
    ws.cell(row, min_col).value = int(value)

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

# Verification read-back
verify_wb = load_workbook(output_path, data_only=True)
verify_ws = verify_wb[ws.title]
print("Written values in", answer_range)
for row in range(min_row, max_row + 1):
    cell = verify_ws.cell(row, min_col)
    print(cell.coordinate, repr(cell.value), type(cell.value).__name__)
